description: Reference control: Hugging Face's unmodified LlamaForCausalLM (transformers 5.24.0) at E0's shapes (hidden 384, 6 layers, 6 heads of 64, SwiGLU 1024, tied embeddings, RoPE theta 10000, RMSNorm eps 1e-6, HF's own init). Same data, loop, optimizer, schedule, eval and checkpointing as E0. 13,767,552 params total / 10,621,824 non-embedding, identical to E0. Implementation differences vs E0: HF init (std 0.02 everywhere, no residual-output scaling), half-split RoPE, eps 1e-6, fp32 RMSNorm.
